heads.en: Expositions on the Song of Songs
THE VOICE OF THE CHURCH AGAIN.

headnotes.la: …icut Cedar habitans in tabernaculis. Cedar fuit filius, ut dicitur Gen. XXV et I Paral. I, Ismael, sed adeo nequam ut a nullo in domo reciperetur, sed semper in tabernaculis habitabat; de quo Origenes
headnotes.en: …lling in tents. Kedar was a son of Ishmael, as is said in Genesis XXV and I Paralipomenon I, but so wicked that he was received by no one in the house, but always dwelt in tents; of whom Origen [says]

headnotes.la: …botrus Cypri,* id est magnum gaudium. Per botrum habemus vinum, in quo est laetitia. Cyprus est locus in quo crescit optimum vinum. Congaudet Ecclesia sponso, sicut de resurrectione et similibus. Dixi
headnotes.en: … joy. By the cluster we have wine, in which is gladness. Cyprus is a place in which the best wine grows. The Church rejoices together with the bridegroom, as over the resurrection and the like. I said

headnotes.la: *Ecce tu pulchra.* Vox sponsi audiens erga se tantam affectionem sponsae quod dixerat
headnotes.en: *Behold, thou art beautiful.* The voice of the bridegroom, hearing toward himself so great an affection of the bride, in that she had said

headnotes.la: Quia tanto amore maneo apud te,
headnotes.en: Because I abide with thee with so great love,

headnotes.la: …, ubique eamdem salvari velimus, et quia naturam nostram diligimus, ad dilectionem Creatoris hujus naturae perducimur, et ita dilectio Dei quae dignior habetur, posterior tempore habetur. Unde Joannes
headnotes.en: …to be saved everywhere; and because we love our own nature, we are led to the love of the Creator of this nature, and so the love of God, which is held the worthier, is held later in time. Whence John

headnotes.la: …hi consolationem ex initiatis et perfectis. Per flores, initia; per mala matura opera, scilicet perfectorum. Sunt enim consolationes sanctorum bona opera aliorum. *Laeva ejus.* Dicit Salomon Prov. III
headnotes.en: …ct. By the flowers, the beginnings; by the apples, the ripe works, namely of the perfect. For the consolations of the saints are the good works of others. *His left hand.* Solomon says in Proverbs III

headnotes.la: et ita hic accipimus per laevam, seu sinistram, temporalia; per dexteram, aeterna. Et inde dicit sponsa
headnotes.en: and so here we understand by the left, or the sinister [hand], temporal things; by the right, eternal things. And thence the bride says

headnotes.la: sed ipse me non deseret, quia
headnotes.en: but he will not desert me, because

headnotes.la: … ipsa velit,* intelligo quod vult ut descendam ad aliquos generandos Deo; ad quod dat mihi exemplum sui et auxilium, de quo item dat nobis Apostolus et exemplum et auctoritatem, cum dicit ad Philip. I
headnotes.en: …wishes me to descend to beget some to God; for which he gives me his own example and help — concerning which the Apostle likewise gives us both example and authority, when he says to the Philippians I

headnotes.la: …as ipsius, et vitam sanctorum annuntia imitandam, in quibus erit refugium ad eorum sectam accedentibus. *Ostende mihi.* Haec quoque verba sunt sponsi, sed Ecclesia repraesentat ea. Dixit mihi sponsus,
headnotes.en: …to be imitated, in which there will be a refuge for those who approach their following. *Show me.* These too are the words of the bridegroom, but the Church represents them. The bridegroom said to me,

headnotes.la: …er hoc dat intelligere hortum ex Judaeis, et hortum ex gentibus. *Emissiones tuae.* Vocavit eam hortum, modo ponit cujusmodi fructum proferat hortus iste, id est mala Punica, et similia, et hoc dicit,
headnotes.en: …rom the Jews, and a garden from the gentiles. *Thy shoots.* He called her a garden; now he sets forth what kind of fruit that garden brings forth, that is, pomegranates and the like; and this he says,

headnotes.la: …are debes quia utilis erit praedicatio tua, et multi convertentur, tum quia conversi tales et tam probi erunt, sicut dictum est, tum quia ego ipse veni proprie eos redimere, unde dictum est, Matth. XV
headnotes.en: …l be useful, and many will be converted, both because when converted they will be such and so worthy, as has been said, and because I myself came properly to redeem them, whence it is said, Matthew 15

headnotes.la: …rum;* sicut enim poma odore suo aliquos attrahunt, ita isti etiam fama sua sibi aliquos attrahunt et sociant. Erunt quidem valde boni illi ultimi Judaeorum, sicut ostendit Apostolus qui dicit, Rom. II
headnotes.en: …for as apples by their smell attract some, so these also by their fame attract some to themselves and associate them. Those last Jews will indeed be very good, as the Apostle shows, who says, Romans 2

headnotes.la: … id est convertam tibi multos de Judaeis qui erunt tibi poculum, id est delectabilis potus, et refectio per bona opera sua, et in multis virtutibus. Cujusmodi potum sitit Deus, ut ipse dixit in cruce,
headnotes.en: …ee many of the Jews, who will be to thee a cup, that is, a delightful drink and refreshment through their good works and in many virtues. Such a drink God thirsts for, as he himself said on the cross,
